integrity.evidence_boundary: Exact finite rational checks supplement the analytic infinite proof.
integrity.provenance: The mathematical argument and reproducibility script are contained in this package.

scientific_limitations: Cycles of order at least three only.
Two independent uniform neighbor offers sampled with replacement.
Minimizes expected cover time, not the full cover-time distribution.
Finite checker diagnostics support but do not prove the all-size theorem.
Historical priority remains subject to wider literature examination.
title: Exact optimal two-choice cover time on finite cycles
